description: What kind of Christian presence a claim asserts. The types are deliberately not a hierarchy: a martyrdom_event does not imply a congregation, and derivation rules must not treat it as if it did.

terms.definition: An organized Christian community met at this place.
The place had a bishop. Implies a congregation only via an explicit derivation rule, never silently.
One or more Christians attested at this place, without evidence of an organized community.
A purpose-built or purpose-adapted Christian meeting place existed here.
A martyrdom of Christians is attested at this place.
